items.what: Final results in the Mississippi (Colom v. Hyde-Smith) and Alaska (Peltola v. Sullivan) Senate races. Mississippi: Hyde-Smith and the NRSC have demanded that affidavit ballots be kept separate, and Colom calls that unlawful. Affidavit cure deadline Nov 10, county certification Nov 13. Alaska: ranked-choice tabulation Nov 18. Update (Nov 17): Mississippi resolved: AP projected Democrat Scott Colom the winner over Hyde-Smith on Nov 11 (https://www.wlox.com/2026/11/11/ap-projects-democrat-scott-colom-winner-highly-contested-mississippi-us-senate-seat/); the certification status was not found. Update (Nov 18): Alaska is still pending (see W-261106-01) and certification is targeted for Nov 25. Mississippi certification status was not found. Update (Nov 19): Alaska resolved: AP called it for Peltola on Nov 17 without RCV, and certification is set for Nov 25. Mississippi certification status not found.
